name: GitHub token
blurb: A personal or fine-grained token, for gh, git over HTTPS and the GitHub API.
guide: Create a fine-grained token at github.com/settings/personal-access-tokens with an expiry.
Give it only the repositories the agent works on, and only what it needs: Contents read and write to push, Pull requests to open them.
Paste it below. In the VM, mwt exec CREDENTIAL -- gh … or git … gives only that command a placeholder. Then add a grant over it: where it may go.

fields.purpose: My GitHub token: gh, git over HTTPS and the GitHub API.
